data.content: IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW BOUNCE: P2a wake notice gives wrong ACK instruction for agent-addressed messages. Source: cli/src/mcp-tools/agent-message-tools.ts writeMessageWakeNotice tells read with agent_message_inbox({agentId}) but ack with agent_message_ack({messageId}) only. Repro against compiled tools: send to persisted agent-bob; notice summary omits agentId; ack({messageId}, recipient context) returns not-found; ack({messageId, agentId:'agent-bob'}) succeeds. Must-fix: include agentId in the ACK instruction whenever message.to.agentId is present, and add a regression proving the generated wake summary/instructions match the actual ack path. Gates checked: build PASS, private-guard PASS, focused P2a tests 22/22 PASS after build; initial pre-build test failure was a dist-clean race from running build in parallel.
